{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Identify internal test orders: those with revenue_clean == 999999.99
internal_test_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
num_internal_test = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of internal test orders (after cleaning): {num_internal_test}")

# Confirm they are all completed
internal_test_completed = data[internal_test_mask]['status'].eq('completed').all()
print(f"All internal test orders are completed? {internal_test_completed}")

# Filter out internal test orders and refunded orders
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (~internal_test_mask)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders excluding internal test orders
total_revenue_completed_cleaned = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue_completed_cleaned"}
